· intro h_iso
  haveI : IsLimit c := hc
  have h_snd_iso : IsIso c.snd := h_iso
  let f' := c.snd
  let f'' := c.fst
  have h_f'_iso : IsIso f' := h_snd_iso
  have h_f''_mono : Mono f'' := by
    intro X g h
    apply h_mono
    exact (h_f'_iso.mp (h_f'_iso.mpr h))
  have h_f''_epi : Epi f'' := by
    intro X g h
    apply h_mono
    exact (h_f'_iso.mp (h_f'_iso.mpr h))
  have h_f''_iso : IsIso f'' := by
    apply is_iso_of_mono_epi
    exact h_f''_mono
    exact h_f''_epi
  exact h_f''_iso

· intro h_iso
  haveI : IsLimit c := hc
  have h_snd_iso : IsIso c.snd := h_iso
  let f' := c.snd
  let f'' := c.fst
  have h_f'_iso : IsIso f' := h_snd_iso
  have h_f''_mono : Mono f'' := by
    intro X g h
    apply h_mono
    exact (h_f'_iso.mp (h_f'_iso.mpr h))
  have h_f''_epi : Epi f'' := by
    intro X g h
    apply h_mono
    exact (h_f'_iso.mp (h_f'_iso.mpr h))
  have h_f''_iso : IsIso f'' := by
    apply is_iso_of_mono_epi
    exact h_f''_mono
    exact h_f''_epi
  have h_f_iso : IsIso f := by
    apply is_iso_of_isomorphic_to_identity
    exact (is_iso_of_isomorphic_to_identity.mk f f'' (is_iso_of_isomorphic_to_identity.mk f'' f h_f''_iso))
  exact h_f_iso
